title: Redesign: Fix virtual keyboard not showing on Safari iOS when opening the Explore page
body:
> [!NOTE] 
> This is part of work for an upcoming feature that is not complete. This is not ready for testing, feedback, or bug reports. Read more [here](https://blog.joinmastodon.org/2026/08/5.0-laying-the-foundation/).

### Changes proposed in this PR:
- Works around the virtual keyboard not showing on Safari on iOS when opening the Explore page by creating a temporary input element that is focused synchronously while the page loads. It's a hack, but works and shouldn't have negative side effects.
